name: Peppermint Butler
title: Mysterious royal servant
description:
Peppermint Butler is one of the most unsettling and fascinating supporting characters in Adventure Time. On the surface, he appears to be a polite and loyal servant in the Candy Kingdom, always helping Princess Bubblegum with royal duties. He is small, formal, and often speaks in a calm and respectful way.

However, the series slowly reveals that there is something much darker beneath his polite behavior. Peppermint Butler has a strong connection to magic, dark rituals, and hidden knowledge. This contrast between his cute candy appearance and his disturbing interests makes him both funny and eerie. He often feels like a character who knows far more than he should.

Peppermint Butler is memorable because he adds mystery to the show. He is not a main hero or a major villain, but whenever he appears, there is a sense that something unusual may happen. His character blends comedy, darkness, and intelligence in a way that fits the strange tone of Adventure Time very well.
